about: What Pitwall's tests expect of this extension (crates/pitwall-app checks every folder under extensions/ against its test/pitwall.json). Nothing here runs a real agent or server.

setup.label: Set up Agention in my agents
lines: codex plugin marketplace add WayfarerLabs/agention --ref v0.7.0

unset: AGENTION_URL (not set until Server address is)

cases.verdict: Agention's server 0.6.0; this extension needs 0.7.0 or later: its install action is offered
“agention” isn't installed: its install action is offered
something else is already listening on 127.0.0.1:8787: that one is used, nothing is started
something else is already listening on 127.0.0.1:8787: that one is used, nothing is started
waits for Server address to be set
isn't started: “0.0.0.0:8787” isn't on this computer only: use 127.0.0.1 and a port

expect: Stops Agention's server and backs up its data first:
Installs Agention 2.0.0 (the installed 1.3.0 is kept for Go back).
If Agention's server is older than 0.7.0 or isn't installed, runs “Install Agention's server here”:
Starts Agention's server and waits until it is up (at most 60 s).
Checks that Agention's server is up and Agention connects as before (within 30 s). If not, it puts back Agention 1.3.0, its data and its service, and says what failed.
Runs “Set up Agention in my agents” again for every account (its commands changed); a failure there doesn't undo the update, and shows Retry:
Claude Code, default: claude plugin marketplace remove agention
Claude Code, default: claude plugin marketplace add WayfarerLabs/agention#v0.7.0
Claude Code, default: claude plugin install agention@agention
Codex, default: codex plugin marketplace remove agention
Codex, default: codex plugin marketplace add WayfarerLabs/agention --ref v0.7.0
Codex, default: codex plugin add agention@agention
agentsSay: 2 running agents keep the previous setup until restarted.
After the update: Pitwall restarts nothing by itself: their rows and this card say so, with Restart.
